description:
Build and check a Skin Lab outfit: wear-rule clashes, attachments, total price and the 3D link. Puts the pieces on in order, the way the viewer and the game do. Pieces that can't be worn together (the
game's own wear rules: two pieces clash when they occupy the same under-layer or over-layer body area - a
Coffee Can Helmet and a Metal Facemask both cover the head) are reported in `clashes` with the piece they
conflict with and why; the first piece wins and the later one is left out of the link, exactly as the viewer
would; a second piece for a viewer slot that's already filled is a clash too. `invalid_attachments` lists
attachments a gun doesn't accept or that fight for the same attachment slot; `errors` lists pieces that
couldn't be resolved (unknown item, or a skin that isn't in 3D yet). `slots` is the
normalised outfit (slot, item, skin, price), `total_price` the sum of the chosen skins' Steam lowest listings
in USD cents (default looks cost nothing; `unpriced` counts skins with no listing), `valid` is true when
nothing was dropped, and `viewer_url` opens the outfit in rust.wiki/skin-lab. Use to put together or check a whole Rust outfit (e.g. 'hoodie with the Tempered skin, metal facemask, AK with a holosight'): it applies the game's wear rules, flags pieces that can't be worn together and why, checks gun attachments, totals the skins' Steam price, and returns a viewer_url showing the outfit in 3D. Find skin itemdefids with search_skins or skinlab_get_item.

face.description: Face (head) name for that body, e.g. `Frank` - list in the error when wrong.

mode.description: Viewer mode for the link: `outfit`, `weapon` (the first piece on its own) or `pov` (first person; needs a gun or tool).

pieces.description: Comma-separated pieces, each `item[:skin[:attachment~attachment]]` - item by shortname or name, skin by itemdefid or name (left out or 0 = default look), attachments for guns. A bare number is a skin itemdefid. Up to 14 pieces, one per viewer slot.

pose.description: Pose key, e.g. `idle`, `wave`, `crouch`, `rifle_aim`, `walk` (default `auto`). Invalid keys are listed in the error.
